title: pilosocereus catingicola subsp. salvadorensis
intro: Pilosocereus catingicola subsp. salvadorensis, commonly known as Salvadorean Pincushion Cactus, is a species of cactus in the genus Pilosocereus. It is a type of cactus plant that belongs to the family Cactaceae and is native to El Salvador. The Salvadorean Pincushion Cactus has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, inflammation, and infections, due to its health benefits such as antioxidant and antimicrobial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antifungal activities.
